name: Numbered steps walk through the app
looks: A window-chrome product screenshot holds centre frame while a small step label ("01 - UPLOAD", "03 - GENERATE") and a one-line instruction sit underneath it. As the flow advances, the screenshot's content changes to the next real app state (an empty upload panel, a populated prompt bar, a results grid) in step with the label changing.
build: Step label cross-fades to the next stage (150-200ms); the instruction line beneath it swaps on the same beat. The screenshot itself is a hard cut to the next real UI state, timed exactly with the label change so the two never feel independent.
sound: A short, clean blip on each step change.
prompt: Walk through a product flow as a sequence of window-chrome screenshots, each paired with a small numbered step label and a one-line instruction underneath; change the label, the instruction and the screenshot's content all on the same beat for each step, so the sequence reads as a clear, numbered walkthrough.
